help.cedarloom-app:
Usage: cedarloom-app [--port <n>] [--no-open] [--plugin-root <dir>] [--json]

Starts the CedarLoom app for the project in the current folder: a local
server on 127.0.0.1 that runs until interrupted. Prints its URL with a
one-time token and opens it in the default browser.

Options:
  --port <n>           Listen on port <n>. 0, the default, takes a free port.
  --no-open            Print the URL without opening the browser.
  --plugin-root <dir>  Use this cl-workflow folder instead of the installed
                       plugin. Its origin is not checked.
  --json               Print one JSON document instead of text.
  --help, -h           Show this usage.
  --version, -V        Print the version of cedarloom-app.
server.open-hint: If the browser shows an error about a file instead of CedarLoom, open the URL printed above.
